quarterly_data.quarter: Kanto Denka Kogyo annual securities report: FY2026 (06-25-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Fiscal year ended March 31, 2026 (annual securities report): net sales rose 4.9% to JPY 65,400 million, mainly on higher Fine Chemicals sales (volume and price), despite the impact of the August 2025 fire at the Shibukawa Plant; operating profit JPY 5,478 million (+28.2%) even as cost of sales rose JPY 1,211 million, mainly on higher raw material prices, and SG&A costs such as personnel expenses increased; ordinary profit JPY 6,629 million (+47.1%), helped by higher foreign-exchange gains; profit attributable to owners of parent JPY 3,785 million (+16.5%) despite a loss from the disaster. Other segments: Basic Chemicals sales JPY 8,010 million (+0.2%), operating profit JPY 109 million (prior year a JPY 578 million loss); Iron-based sales JPY 1,915 million (-16.8%), operating profit JPY 161 million (-54.6%); Trading sales JPY 767 million (+15.8%); Equipment sales JPY 2,169 million (+13.7%). Management states the chemical industry saw growing demand in semiconductors and electronic materials from the rapid progress of generative AI, while raw-material procurement stayed unstable and procurement prices volatile because of geopolitical risks, so the business environment remained difficult.
quarterly_data.figure: Net sales JPY 65,400 million (+4.9%); operating profit JPY 5,478 million (+28.2%); ordinary profit JPY 6,629 million (+47.1%)

quarterly_data.quarter: Kanto Denka Kogyo annual securities report: FY2026 (06-25-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Fine Chemicals, fiscal year ended March 31, 2026 (annual securities report): sales JPY 52,536 million (+6.2%), operating profit JPY 4,903 million (+22.6%). Specialty gases: nitrogen trifluoride sales fell on lower volume caused by the Shibukawa Plant fire; tungsten hexafluoride sales rose on price revisions and higher volume; KSG-14 sales rose on higher volume. Battery materials: lithium hexafluorophosphate sales rose on higher volume and price revisions; no technical support fees under the licence agreement arose this year. Production (at selling prices): Fine Chemicals JPY 50,473 million (+9.3%), group total JPY 64,285 million (+6.5%). Sales by customer location: Japan JPY 32,847 million, Asia JPY 30,284 million (including Korea JPY 16,429 million), Europe and the Americas JPY 2,267 million.
quarterly_data.figure: Fine Chemicals sales JPY 52,536 million (+6.2%); operating profit JPY 4,903 million (+22.6%); Korea sales JPY 16,429 million

quarterly_data.quarter: Kanto Denka Kogyo annual securities report: FY2026 (06-25-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Shibukawa Plant fire (annual securities report): management states the nitrogen trifluoride production plant at the Shibukawa Plant (Shibukawa, Gunma), where a fire occurred in August 2025, has been restored and, after safety measures were taken and permission from the authorities was received, has resumed operation while safety is confirmed; recurrence-prevention steps at the affected workplace include added indicator lamps showing equipment pressure, stronger on-site identification labels and a review of equipment operating methods.

quarterly_data.quarter: Kanto Denka Kogyo annual securities report: FY2026 (06-25-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: R&D, fiscal year ended March 31, 2026 (annual securities report): R&D investment JPY 2,304 million. Specialty gases for semiconductors and LCDs: fluorine-based specialty gases such as NF3, CF4, C4F6 and WF6 are widely used for etching, chamber cleaning and deposition, and the company describes itself as one of the world's leading makers of semiconductor and LCD specialty gases in production capacity and quality; it aims to supply C4F6 (hexafluorobutadiene), COS (carbonyl sulfide) and CH3F (monofluoromethane) as semiconductor scaling advances and focus on high-performance gases and new materials for etching, cleaning and deposition to meet rising demand for AI semiconductors (GPUs), high-bandwidth memory (HBM) and leading-edge memory; for new gases such as KSG-14 and KSG-5 it is building a patent network to keep high entry barriers and pursuing further customer evaluation and sales expansion, and it is installing semiconductor evaluation equipment step by step. Kanto Denka Fine Products Korea, set up in Korea in 2017, produces COS and other products and has also done R&D since November 2023 to develop close to local customers. Battery materials: after LiPF6 (sales from 1997), LiBF4 (April 2017) and LiPO2F2 (April 2022), construction of production facilities for a new additive is complete and the additive is under new qualification evaluation; with an outside partner the company developed technology to recover high-purity lithium from used lithium-ion batteries and is building a plant targeting operation start in the second half of the fiscal year beginning April 2027.

quarterly_data.quarter: Kanto Denka Kogyo annual securities report: FY2026 (06-25-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Medium-term plan (annual securities report): the 12th medium-term management plan ('Dominate 1000'), started in the fiscal year beginning April 2022 and originally aimed at consolidated net sales of JPY 1,000 hundred million in the fiscal year beginning April 2024, had its final year extended by two years after a review reflecting the changed business environment and results; final-year targets: net sales JPY 1,000 hundred million, operating profit JPY 150 hundred million, ROE 12% or more, ROIC 8% or more (the year ended March 2026, the plan's fourth year: net sales JPY 654 hundred million, operating profit JPY 5,478 million). Management's strategy: grow specialty gases by developing and investing in proprietary products as new gases are needed with market growth and technology change, build a stable-supply system with multiple manufacturing sites as semiconductor investment is active in many countries, and develop close to customers; in battery materials, where EV growth has slowed, capture expected demand in the US, Europe and Japan, expand the licence business and complete as planned the lithium-ion battery recycling plant it decided to build; the transfer of carrier production to Kanto Denka Fine Tech was completed in the fiscal year beginning April 2025 and the former carrier site's resources will be concentrated on Fine Chemicals.
quarterly_data.figure: Targets: net sales JPY 1,000 hundred million; operating profit JPY 150 hundred million; ROE 12% or more; ROIC 8% or more
